integrity: Mathematical proof is self-contained; the enumerative and symbolic scripts provide reproducibility corroboration. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
msc_ownership_rationale: 60C05 combinatorial probability: exact conditional expectations and covariance for uniformly sampled permutations; enumeration is a proof technique, not the primary research object.
scientific_limitations: Exact first moments only for length-three non-wrapping patterns in uniform n-cycles with n>=4; no joint law, longer patterns or general cycle types claimed.
title: Exact three-pattern bias in uniform single-cycle permutations
